description: Sparse infill density incremental behavior mutants.

mutants.description: Omitting new-density-zero perimeter invalidation must leave stale odd-layer alternate walls on 20%->0%; the fresh-zero perimeter geometry and incremental snapshot comparison should fail.
Omitting old-density-zero perimeter invalidation must leave the 0%->20% incremental print without odd-layer alternate walls; the fresh-20 snapshot and transition oracle should fail.
Omitting unconditional posPrepareInfill must leave the 20%->40% sparse output stale; fresh-40 equality and the positive density-change witness should fail.
